content.generation_focus: Training-based methods; geometry-aware sampling; constraint parameterization; guidance, correction and search; combinations.
content.subtitle: From Constrained Prediction to Constrained Generation.
content.word_count_method: Whitespace-delimited article text excluding references; pre-rendered expressions counted once via their TeX source.

boundaries: Prediction families can overlap; an operation has different training requirements in a layer and in post-processing.
Constraint parameterization includes coefficients, distribution parameters and coordinates; sampling feasible points and taking their mean differ on nonconvex sets.
Local prefix validity need not ensure feasible completion.
Training supervision on an estimate, completed rollout or population statistic supports different claims; loss reduction alone does not guarantee all outputs.
Geometry-aware sampling includes reflection and manifold dynamics; the figure shows the manifold case.
Parameterization requires valid coordinates and a valid map; approximate maps need evidence and coverage is separate.
Guidance, correction and search are related interventions, not mutually exclusive families; the object, timing and operation matter.
A finite search budget or better objective value need not produce a feasible output.
Later operations can undo earlier feasibility; assess the complete procedure, its output distribution and cost.

changes.finding: Repeated definitions interrupted the prediction-to-generation transition.
changes.resolution: Background appears once in section 5; section 6 starts from the whole-trajectory sample and its two time axes.

changes.finding: Update/model, guidance/fitting and candidate/coordinate objects were easy to conflate.
changes.resolution: Separate operation glyphs, state-gradient and parameter-feedback arrows, and c/u notation.

changes.finding: The training loss had no forward input.
changes.resolution: Next state feeds an output readout/map/correction, which then supplies the loss.

changes.finding: All intermediate corrections appeared to need transfer back into sampling.
changes.resolution: Transfer applies specifically to corrected output estimates; direct state correction can act on the state.

changes.finding: The coordinate-domain curve looked like a physical path.
changes.resolution: A single coordinate-vector point represents an entire path.
Full-width editorial rows on desktop; stacked title, diagram and caption on mobile.

changes.resolution: Unchanged area/count encoding and explicit coincident sample counts; no jitter.

validation_reuse: Revision 20 checks current classification diagrams and article layout in Chromium and WebKit at 360/390/768/1440, no-JS figures/sections, TOC anchors, rendered math errors, and 8030 numerical checks. Older touch, keyboard, shared-site navigation and performance measurements retain their historical revisions; they were not repeated for this prose/diagram edit.

groups: General neural network and analytic flow illustrations
changes: Prediction roles use explicit deployed computation and loss nodes, with derivative paths through a layer/decoder only when trained through it.
The base sampler separates learned model evaluation from numerical integration and terminal output selection.
Forward Universal Guidance modifies predicted noise before the sampler using the clean-estimate loss gradient with respect to the noisy state.
Projected Diffusion shows repeated projected inner iterations at a fixed noise level.
PCFM shows endpoint shooting, Gauss-Newton correction, OT interpolation with the original prior draw, relaxed endpoint-residual correction, repetition and a final solve.
Riemannian flow uses tangent dynamics on a unit-circle illustration; a separate explicit sigmoid/b-q decoder explains coordinate parameterization.
Training adaptation is described separately from inference operations. Native diffusion and flow time conventions are stated.
preserved: Numerical methods, seeds, sample coordinates, tolerance and equal plot scales.
Constraint scope and distinction between sampler steps and physical path time.

general_illustrations.creation: Original SVG architecture and analytic toy transport in the existing generator.
general_illustrations.notation: Phi_theta, f_theta and v_theta use SVG tspan subscripts; positive vertical offsets verified in both engines.
general_illustrations.scope: Hand-specified 4-3-2 ReLU MLP with affine layers; 44 quantile particles under an analytic transport to a toy target. Neither is trained or experimental.

mathematics.MLP: affine combinations, ReLU and affine readout; explicit toy weights and biases in metadata
mathematics.flow: T(z)=1.15 tanh(1.8z)+0.32z; positive derivative; monotone interpolation with smoothstep; endpoint densities use change of variables
mathematics.constraint_scope: general illustrations do not encode output constraints
